# How much CIS tax have contractors held back, and how much will you get back?

> Free UK CIS calculator for subcontractors: see the 20% or 30% deduction on an invoice, estimate your Self Assessment bill and Class 4 NI, and find out how much CIS tax you can claim back. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
